default/32271.htm.text: Water Dragon's Shamaness Parme: The Shamaness' eyes stare into space, blank and unfocused. There are no visible injunes, but she looks as though she is under some kind of evil spell.

Q00131_BirdInACage/32271-01.html.text: Water Dragon's Shamaness Parme: The Shamaness' eyes stare into space, blank and unfocused. She is in no state to carry on a conversation.

Q00131_BirdInACage/32271-02.html.text: Water Dragon's Shamaness Parme: (Suddenly, an ethereal and sorrowful melody begins to flow from the Echo Crystal you received from Kanis. The Shamaness' body is engulfed in light, and her eyes come back into focus as she clutches her head and shrieks in pain. A moment later... She seems to recover,…

Q00131_BirdInACage/32271-03.html.text: Water Dragon's Shamaness Parme: (As she listens, the Shamaness continues to tenderly hold her head in her hands.) Uhh... Uhh... ... Ahh! I remember everything now. Thank you very much. There is so much to tell, but... It would be best to leave this place first. I will go to a secret location to tak…

links.text: Take the letter and wait until the spell is complete.

Q00131_BirdInACage/32271-04.html.text: Water Dragon's Shamaness Parme: While being teleported through the power of the Shamaness, you hear her final whisper in your ear: The name of the one who destroyed the Oracle and trapped me in this place is... Be...le...th...
